title: A time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition combined with improper symbolic link handling in the privileged…
description: A TOCTOU race condition combined with improper symbolic link handling in the privileged helper of TeamViewer Full Client and Host for macOS prior to version 15.83 allows a local attacker with low privileges to bypass installer package verification and install a malicious package. This can lead to local privilege escalation to root.
